top_comments: This is how music videos SHOULD be. An actual storyline!!!
Now I want 5 seasons of this
Ella is the first country artist that's felt like 90s-00s country in a long time
Not since the 90's have we had anything this good
If this was a movie trailer, I would keep watching the movie over and over again
Everyone who reads this, we don't know each other and probably never will but I wish you all the best in life and all the luck in the world

I was born and raised here in Nashville, TN. In 2015 I met a Texas boy who had just graduated college and moved to TN to live with his older brother for the summer. We were together for a year and he told me he was homesick for Texas, but wanted me to go back with him. His childhood sweetheart and first love was back in TX and I was scared to death this exact scenario was in store for me. So I went with him. Up and moved my life to Texas with him. We bought a house and lived there barely a year and he told me one day he realized I was where home was for him now, not Texas. So we got engaged, got married, got pregnant and moved back to Tennessee to have our first child together. That was 11 years ago and i’m now pregnant with our 2nd child and we just built our forever home on several acres here in TN. ❤️
Never listened to country before. This song is absolutely beautiful. Such soft melodies but yet very emotional. This will be a timeless song for sure. Love from Sweden  🇸🇪❤🇺🇲
hell of a pilot episode

Fun fact: The awning over the door at 5:00 was built by me and my dad in a day... everyone loved it, even the venue owners (who were considering keeping it as a permanent installation).

Loved working on this video!

I was born and raised here in Nashville, TN. In 2015 I met a Texas boy who had just graduated college and moved to TN to live with his older brother for the summer. We were together for a year and he told me he was homesick for Texas, but wanted me to go back with him. His childhood sweetheart and first love was back in TX and I was scared to death this exact scenario was in store for me. So I went with him. Up and moved my life to Texas with him. We bought a house and lived there barely a year and he told me one day he realized I was where home was for him now, not Texas. So we got engaged, got married, got pregnant and moved back to Tennessee to have our first child together. That was 11 years ago and i’m now pregnant with our 2nd child and we just built our forever home on several acres here in TN. ❤️
Never listened to country before. This song is absolutely beautiful. Such soft melodies but yet very emotional. This will be a timeless song for sure. Love from Sweden  🇸🇪❤🇺🇲

video.video_title: Rejected His Whole Life… But He Never Stopped Choosing Love
video.video_description:
✨ He was rejected by his own kind… but all he ever wanted was love. Beimma isn’t just a massive bull—he’s a gentle soul who never gave up on connection, even after loss and loneliness. This story will change the way you see farm animals forever. Watch till the end… it’s worth it. 📩

Follow us on:
Instagram:https://www.instagram.com/guardiansoulsstories/

If you love emotional rescue stories, inspiring transformations, and real-life animal miracles, this page is for you.
Subscribe for weekly stories that remind us: healing begins with love. 🐾💛

#guardiansoulsstories #animalstory #animalrescue #heartwarmingstories #petstories #bull #cow #cowlife
top_comments:
Original source: https://www.instagram.com/sashafarm/
This story originates from those who quietly dedicate their lives to protecting and rescuing animals. It carries not only emotion, but also truth, compassion, and the value of second chances.
We share it with deep respect, simply to help its message reach a little further.
All credit remains with the original creator. 💛
You can see his beautiful soul in those kind eyes.
So sad to see an animal so rejected.Well done for giving him such a warm home
He's like a big puppy dog, hes literally a gentle giant
This story 100% would make beautiful children's book.
He looks like a Basset hound! He's so adorable.

That picture with him standing in the doorway with the 2 goats is beautiful and perfect.
It deserves to be framed.❤
Animals aren't machinery. They are loving giving beings. Gentle souls that need the same love they give us ❤❤❤
What a beautiful animal and bless you for adopting him .
I've never seen an animal exude such gentleness and sensitivity.

video.video_title: Dramatic Dog Screams Over Nail Clippers
video.video_description:
Hello everyone, we've got some VERY VERY good dogs for you today, so we hope you enjoy.

In this video, a dramatic Rottweiler puppy has a full meltdown when his nails are clipped. He gets my nominee for world's most dramatic dog 🤣!

Also in this video, a happy dog can't stop bouncing on his morning walk, an adorable Dachshund puppy gets the hiccups and dog has the guiltiest smile you'll ever see.

If you love dogs and want to see more: Please like and subscribe: 

Music:
Days of Joy - J.F. Gloss
The Non-Essential - The Fly Guy Five
Wrecked Me Good - Donell Mase
Music licensed from Epidemic Sound.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Welcome to The Woof World, your one stop shop for your daily dose of dogs. 

My goal is to bring dog lovers across the globe together by sharing the most viral, heartwarming and funny clips, all in one place. 

I currently upload 2 to 3 times a week and always aim to keep the videos the best quality I can. Every video I share is either posted with permission or properly licensed.
video_tags: Dramatic Dog Gets Scared Of Nail Clippers
top_comments: This year, the best actor award from the academy goes to Mr Rot.
The nail clipper clip gets my vote 😂😂😂
I love how the Rottweiler just cries out but leaves his paw in her hands. You would think he would pull it away if it really hurt 😢. That’s hilarious 😂
I wish my dogs only howled. Nooooooo my dogs suddenly discover their parkour talents.
Dogs make the world a better place🥰🥰
THAT LAST DOG TOOK ME OUTTA HERE THAT WAS HIS EVERYDAY MASSAGE 😂😂😂😂😂😂
Los perritos son un amor
The nail clip deserves an Academy Award.😁😅
AWWWW SUCH CUTENESS OVERLOAD!!!  BEAUTIFUL HEALTHY DOGS!!
I’m in total love with all these fabulous sweethearts.  They are all awesome and so precious with great personalities. They all are such funny characters ❤❤❤❤❤❤❤😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂❤❤❤❤❤❤❤

video.video_title: Pitbull Throws The Biggest Tantrum Ever When Grandma Says No
video.video_description:
Meet Kairo — the most dramatic pitbull on the internet.

This 70-pound "tough guy" wears pajamas, refuses to leave the 
house without his favorite blanket, and throws a complete tantrum 
every time he doesn't get his way. And the one thing that breaks 
him every single time? Not being invited to Grandma's house.

Welcome to the daily life of a pitbull who acts like a five-year-old 
kid in a muscle suit.

📸 Original content by https://www.instagram.com/kairoandwillow on Instagram  — go follow Kairo and his husky sister Willow for more daily drama.

#funnydogs #dramaticpets #pitbull #funnyanimals #dogsofyoutube 
#funnypitbull #spoileddog #dogtantrum

#pitbull #rescuedog #bullybreed #dogsofyoutube #kairoandwillow

Not getting invited to Grandma’s house being his biggest heartbreak is honestly the cutest thing ever 😂 What a giant baby.
That side eye is deadly. 😅❤ Poor Kairo! ❤❤😊❤❤
Oh give him a kiss, a hug and whatever he wants.  Kairo is adorable.
Kairo is so cute. I love his faces when he has a tantrum when he can't get his way. He face is so adorable.
This is a great story.  He just needs to feel welcome everywhere.  Kairo is the best. 🥰
This pup is completely spoiled and they love it!
The side eye is epic😂😂
All of those “side eye” glances just made me laugh.  😂
Tantrum? More like a pout.

video.video_title: TV Royale | EVO Princess, HERO Tombstone, NEW Game Mode, and MORE!
video.video_description:
Check the Patch Notes: https://supr.cl/Update_June26

Coming with the update:
🃏 Collection Levels
💎 Mastery Rework

Over the next season:
❄️ EVO Princess
💀 HERO Tombstone
👑 Princess Gambit
🏟️ Seasonal Arenas
🩷 Victory Run Event

X ► https://twitter.com/ClashRoyale/
Instagram ► https://www.instagram.com/clashroyale
TikTok ► https://www.tiktok.com/@clashroyale
Facebook ► https://www.facebook.com/ClashRoyale/

ENTER THE ARENA
Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world!

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Tower Troops from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards!

See you in the Arena!
#ClashRoyale
top_comments:
Evo is legendary card.
Hero is rare card.
We can see it.
The "Hero Tombstone" ability is a 6-Elixir ability,, god dang

So in Princess gambit it's going to be my 13 level cards vs my opponent level 16 cards
How nice
2:33 Supercell you ain't tuff bro🥀💔
3:44 hell nah

Okay so
-Evo is the princess (only legendary that could shoot frozen arrows)
-Hero is the tombstone (was leaked months ago, and the hero card looks like a common, rare or epic rarity)
I don't know whether to laugh or cry.
so you need every single card in the game maxed in the new gamemode … wow😂
1:10 yeah but like what about the people that have literally maxed out their cards💀

"Do you remember the seasonal-"
YES!
"Arena?"
Aw

persona.last_active: 今天 (首次活跃 8 天前)

video.video_title: TV Royale | EVO Princess, HERO Tombstone, NEW Game Mode, and MORE!
video.video_description:
Check the Patch Notes: https://supr.cl/Update_June26

Coming with the update:
🃏 Collection Levels
💎 Mastery Rework

Over the next season:
❄️ EVO Princess
💀 HERO Tombstone
👑 Princess Gambit
🏟️ Seasonal Arenas
🩷 Victory Run Event

X ► https://twitter.com/ClashRoyale/
Instagram ► https://www.instagram.com/clashroyale
TikTok ► https://www.tiktok.com/@clashroyale
Facebook ► https://www.facebook.com/ClashRoyale/

ENTER THE ARENA
Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world!

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Tower Troops from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards!

See you in the Arena!
#ClashRoyale

Hero is rare card.

So in Princess gambit it's going to be my 13 level cards vs my opponent level 16 cards
How nice
2:33 Supercell you ain't tuff bro🥀💔
3:44 hell nah

Okay so
-Evo is the princess (only legendary that could shoot frozen arrows)
-Hero is the tombstone (was leaked months ago, and the hero card looks like a common, rare or epic rarity)
I don't know whether to laugh or cry.
so you need every single card in the game maxed in the new gamemode … wow😂
1:10 yeah but like what about the people that have literally maxed out their cards💀

"Do you remember the seasonal-"
YES!
"Arena?"
Aw

video.video_title: Pokémon Champions – Overview Trailer – Nintendo Switch
video.video_description:
The Pokémon Champions game launches April 8, 2026 on the Nintendo Switch system. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-champions-switch/

Pokémon battles for everyone! Recruit Pokémon in-game or transfer them from Pokémon HOME, then gear up for thrilling battles with Trainers near and far! Compete in three different modes of Pokémon battles: Ranked Battles, Casual Battles, and Private Battles. You can challenge these modes in both Single Battle and Double Battle formats. Plus, use in-game Victory Points (VP) you’ve earned to improve a Pokémon’s stats, acquire new looks for your Trainer, and more!

The game is also compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 system. 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot

Follow Nintendo of America
X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/NintendoAmerica
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NintendoAmerica
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nintendoamerica
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/nintendo
top_comments: Oh yeah, this is gonna be good
Nintendo YouTubers: Everything you MISSED in the Pokémon Champions Trailer

my dad got super into the pokemon tcg phone game last year. when i saw the details of this game i was telling him about it and how fun it would be to battle against each other on mobile. unfortunately he passed away in december. rest in peace, gonna be thinking about you when i play this
Close enough, welcome back Battle Revolution.
For Tomodachi life they had to explain  what a Mii is and now they explained how to fight in a turn based setting. I knew I was old, but I didnt know I was almost dead.
Z-A mega starters be like: let's all get new unique abilities and not tell emboar!

*You'll be able to see your opponent's team*

Zoroark: That's illegal
It's been a few years since I've been into competitive PKMN Battles, but I actually look forward to getting back into it again
Are you telling me. Meganium can now just fire off solar beams whenever it wants to. Oh boy.
I can't remember the last time a trailer explained to me how pokemon battles work

video.video_title: Pokémon Champions – Overview Trailer – Nintendo Switch
video.video_description:
The Pokémon Champions game launches April 8, 2026 on the Nintendo Switch system. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-champions-switch/

Pokémon battles for everyone! Recruit Pokémon in-game or transfer them from Pokémon HOME, then gear up for thrilling battles with Trainers near and far! Compete in three different modes of Pokémon battles: Ranked Battles, Casual Battles, and Private Battles. You can challenge these modes in both Single Battle and Double Battle formats. Plus, use in-game Victory Points (VP) you’ve earned to improve a Pokémon’s stats, acquire new looks for your Trainer, and more!

The game is also compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 system. 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot

Follow Nintendo of America
X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/NintendoAmerica
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NintendoAmerica
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nintendoamerica
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/nintendo
top_comments: Oh yeah, this is gonna be good
Nintendo YouTubers: Everything you MISSED in the Pokémon Champions Trailer

my dad got super into the pokemon tcg phone game last year. when i saw the details of this game i was telling him about it and how fun it would be to battle against each other on mobile. unfortunately he passed away in december. rest in peace, gonna be thinking about you when i play this
Close enough, welcome back Battle Revolution.
For Tomodachi life they had to explain  what a Mii is and now they explained how to fight in a turn based setting. I knew I was old, but I didnt know I was almost dead.
Z-A mega starters be like: let's all get new unique abilities and not tell emboar!

*You'll be able to see your opponent's team*

Zoroark: That's illegal
It's been a few years since I've been into competitive PKMN Battles, but I actually look forward to getting back into it again
Are you telling me. Meganium can now just fire off solar beams whenever it wants to. Oh boy.
I can't remember the last time a trailer explained to me how pokemon battles work

video.video_title: Splatoon Raiders — Release Date Revealed — Nintendo Switch 2
video.video_description:
The Splatoon Raiders game launches July 23, 2026, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/splatoon-raiders-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1028-01&utm_id=S1028-01

Splat scores of enemies with colored ink and go treasure hunting in #SplatoonRaiders, a new single-player-focused game! Play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut, a trio of swashbuckling musicians, and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands! Customize your appearance, equip mechanical gadgets and ink-splattering weapons, and take on hordes of aggressive sea creatures called Salmonids in search of treasure.

#SplatoonRaiders #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/splatoon-raiders-switch-2/

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot

Follow Nintendo of America
X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/NintendoAmerica
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NintendoAmerica
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nintendoamerica
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/nintendo
top_comments: Whether you want to live as a Pokemon on an Island, as a Mii on an Island or a Squid on an Island, Nintendo got you covered!
They really do always announce these on a random Tuesday

For the first time in series history

The level design is NOT composed entirely of blocks floating in the sky

"What is it with you and islands?"
"I just think they're neat!"
When your Salmon Run team is so bad, you sail off into the ocean to deal with them all on your own.
The best thing about this game is how the idols are actually involved in the combat and not just cheerleading from the sidelines

A sprinkle of Side Order here, a sprinkle of Salmon Run there...

Ah, yes, this is the recipe for "its peak, I'm afraid"
Low key OBSESSED with Shiver and Frye's new outfits
Ah yes, because this is what you CASUALLY DROP on a TUESDAY MORNING WITH NO WARNING
seeing nintendo acknowledge this game again was an actual jumpscare

video.video_title: FIRST LOOK: SULFUR CUBE & CAVES | Minecraft LIVE – March 2026
video.video_description:
Venture underground to discover the sulfur cube and the sulfur caves! Agnes, Daniel, and Marco give us a tour of this pungent yet beautiful biome, its bubbling springs, colorful blocks, and curious little cube mob. The sulfur cube is an unassuming mob – until you feed it a block! Then, it takes on different physics-based qualities based on what it just ingested. Test the sulfur cube and more features from the Chaos Cubed drop soon! 

Minecraft LIVE: https://youtube.com/live/Is5IswM87EQ 

American Sign Language: https://youtube.com/live/-uQFmnbPZPo 
British Sign Language: https://youtube.com/live/bj_Z0XAsuvE 
Audio Description: https://youtube.com/live/Buh2UiDT7kM 

Check out Minecraft.net for more information!   
https://www.minecraft.net/
top_comments: I have a feeling this was a scrapped caves and cliffs feature that they brought back.
We are getting severe neurological, kidney, and respiratory damage in Minecraft before gta6
As a child, I yearned for the intoxicating fumes of the sulfur mines.
The end will literally get updated in the end of Minecrafts lifetime 😭

Please tell us we’re able to feed these guys tnt so we can light the tnt up and turn these guys into weapons

UPDATE: they didn’t do it, someone PLEASE tell them to do it :(

UPDATE TWO: they actually did it. LETS GO
One must imagine the Sulfur cube happy
Caves and Cliffs Part 5

Hope we can get polished, walls and brick variants for some already existing stone types in this update too
(Calcite, dripstone, basalt)
Sulfur better actually do something, this would be like adding gunpowder and making it a building material
Sulfur is a key component to make gunpowder. They could give gunpowder a recipe with something related to the sulfur blocks.

video.video_title: Why are ships painted red below the waterline?
video.video_description:
Anti-fouling red paint is a crucial feature of maritime engineering that protects ocean vessels from structural damage. In this video, we explain why ships are painted red below the waterline step by step using real maritime history and verified chemical science.

Why Are Ships Painted Red Below the Waterline? | Simple Things Surprising Histories

This documentary-style episode from Simple Things Surprising Histories covers the complete history and science of anti-fouling paint, from ancient wooden galleons to modern commercial shipping.

Topics covered in this video:
• Why almost all massive ships are painted red at the bottom
• What marine biofouling is and how it damages ships
• The history of shipworms and barnacles destroying wooden hulls
• How copper sheets protected 18th-century sailing vessels
• Why iron and steel ships cannot use raw copper on their hulls
• The invention of anti-fouling paint
• What copper oxide is and why it naturally appears rusty red
• The chemical reaction between salt water, iron, and copper
• Why maritime tradition keeps ship bottoms red today
• How the stark red contrast helps sailors monitor the Plimsoll Line

Chapters:
00:00 -  Intro: The Bold Red Line 
00:56 - Chapter 1: The Ocean’s Hitchhikers 
01:54 - Chapter 2: The Copper Shield 
02:58 - Chapter 3: The Weight of Tradition 
03:52 - Outro: An Ocean Legacy 

This video is designed for students, educators, and general audiences who want a clear explanation of maritime history and engineering without unnecessary complexity. All explanations are factual, educational, and suitable for learning purposes.

anti fouling paint explained
maritime history documentary

plimsoll line explained,
this video provides a complete and accurate overview.

top_comments: thank GOD a video thats not 3 hours long to explain something this simple
This is why I love these kinds of videos. Something you see all the time, but never stop to question.
Thanks for this video. I'm 49 years old and never knew why ships are red at the bottom. Now I can finish my beer, watch another youtube video and move on with my life. Farewell, friend.
I ENJOYED THIS DEEP DIVE, AS I NEVER KNEW THIS
Brilliantly put together

Because traditionally the paint contained Cuprous Oxide (from copper) giving it the red colour. Also contained some lead. However this type of 'antifouling' paint while successful in slowing barnacle & weed growth, was found to be toxic to all marine life so is being discontinued. However in keeping with tradition some ship builders for companies still paint the undrwater hull red but without any harmful components. Master Mariner Class 1.

top_comments: Yeah, guitar players know that pocket very well as where you keep your pick(s). A pick pocket if you will.
When I was younger, I was told it was where you keep your durex .
It's where you keep your money from your paycheck after taxes😅
I used to keep a £5 note in it for emergencies. 65 years ago, £5 was a lot of money.
I knew it was watch pocket. I remember when jeans were called "dungarees".
Here in the UK it was known as a ticket pocket, bus, train, whatever, you knew exactly where to look when the conductor asked for proof.
I thought it nonsense that a watch would fit in that small pocket, so I dug out my grandfather's British Great War pocket watch and it fits perfectly!
I didn’t know what it was for. That is lovely to know, and that they kept it in memory of the hard workers. ❤
I seem to recollect that, a "packet of three", fitted perfectly.
They're called the watch pockets for a reason they used to carry pocket watches

top_comments: Yeah, guitar players know that pocket very well as where you keep your pick(s). A pick pocket if you will.
When I was younger, I was told it was where you keep your durex .
It's where you keep your money from your paycheck after taxes😅
I used to keep a £5 note in it for emergencies. 65 years ago, £5 was a lot of money.
I knew it was watch pocket. I remember when jeans were called "dungarees".
Here in the UK it was known as a ticket pocket, bus, train, whatever, you knew exactly where to look when the conductor asked for proof.
I thought it nonsense that a watch would fit in that small pocket, so I dug out my grandfather's British Great War pocket watch and it fits perfectly!
I didn’t know what it was for. That is lovely to know, and that they kept it in memory of the hard workers. ❤
I seem to recollect that, a "packet of three", fitted perfectly.
They're called the watch pockets for a reason they used to carry pocket watches

Internet cookies are tiny packets of data that play a critical role in modern web browsing and online privacy. In this video, we explain what cookies are and what happens when you click "Accept All" step by step using real computer science and verified internet history.

Internet Cookies Explained: What Happens When You Click "Accept All"? | Simple Things Surprising Histories

This documentary-style episode from Simple Things Surprising Histories covers the complete history and function of internet cookies, from their innocent invention to their current use in global digital tracking.

Topics covered in this video:
• What internet cookies are and why they were invented
• The history of the early web and Lou Montulli's creation
• How HTTP cookies give web browsers a "memory"
• First-party cookies and how they keep you logged in
• The coat-check analogy for digital data storage
• What third-party cookies are and who creates them
• How advertisers and data brokers use tracking cookies
• Exactly what happens when you click "Accept All"
• How your online profile is built and sold in milliseconds
• How to protect your privacy by rejecting non-essential cookies

video.video_title: Why Am I Always Horny - Sexual Intrusive Thoughts Explained
video.video_description:
Sudden sexual urges can feel confusing, especially when they show up out of nowhere—but there’s actually a psychological reason behind them. In this video, we explore why you get random sexual thoughts, the role of intrusive sexual thoughts in psychology, and what it really means if you’re thinking “why am I always horny.” We’ll also talk about how to control sexual urges in a healthy, realistic way—without shame or judgment.

References and sources used in this video: 

Baumeister, R. F., & Vohs, K. D. (2007). Self-regulation, ego depletion, and motivation. Social and Personality Psychology Compass, 1(1), 115–128.

Bancroft, J., & Vukadinovic, Z. (2004). Sexual addiction, sexual compulsivity, sexual impulsivity, or what? Toward a theoretical model. Journal of Sex Research, 41(3), 225–234.

Georgiadis, J. R., & Kringelbach, M. L. (2012). The human sexual response cycle: Brain imaging evidence linking sex to other pleasures. Progress in Neurobiology, 98(1), 49–81.

Do you have a topic you would like to request from us? Let us know in the comments. 
Also, you can reach out to us here: tu@psych2go.net   
Also, don't forget to check out our: Meditation Series here: https://youtu.be/WmpXj-P_vCA?si=NkIBG12VBMv0Mtm9

video.video_title: Why Am I Always Horny - Sexual Intrusive Thoughts Explained
video.video_description:
Sudden sexual urges can feel confusing, especially when they show up out of nowhere—but there’s actually a psychological reason behind them. In this video, we explore why you get random sexual thoughts, the role of intrusive sexual thoughts in psychology, and what it really means if you’re thinking “why am I always horny.” We’ll also talk about how to control sexual urges in a healthy, realistic way—without shame or judgment.

References and sources used in this video: 

Baumeister, R. F., & Vohs, K. D. (2007). Self-regulation, ego depletion, and motivation. Social and Personality Psychology Compass, 1(1), 115–128.

Bancroft, J., & Vukadinovic, Z. (2004). Sexual addiction, sexual compulsivity, sexual impulsivity, or what? Toward a theoretical model. Journal of Sex Research, 41(3), 225–234.

Georgiadis, J. R., & Kringelbach, M. L. (2012). The human sexual response cycle: Brain imaging evidence linking sex to other pleasures. Progress in Neurobiology, 98(1), 49–81.

Also, you can reach out to us here: tu@psych2go.net

video.video_title: If you have potatoes and ground beef… make THIS for dinner!
video.video_description:
Looking for a simple and delicious dinner idea? If you have potatoes and ground beef in your kitchen, you have everything you need to create this incredibly comforting family meal!

In this video, I’ll show you how to turn these basic staples into a gourmet-style layered bake. The secret is in the creamy, savory sauce and a special "hidden" ingredient that brings all the flavors together. It’s so easy to prepare, and the result is a golden, cheesy masterpiece that your family will ask for every single week!

This is the ultimate comfort food, perfect for busy weeknights when you want something hearty but don’t want to spend hours in the kitchen.

In this video, you’ll see:

• How to prep the perfect savory beef base.
• My trick for beautifully layered, tender potatoes.
• The simple steps to making a rich, velvety cream sauce.
• How to get that perfect golden-brown cheesy crust every time.

➡️ Click "CC" in the lower-right menu to select your subtitle language 😋 

❤️ My Instagram 🤗 https://www.instagram.com/EssenRecipes 

👉 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and share this video if you enjoy it — it helps more than you know!

➡️ 🖨️ PRINTABLE RECIPE with Full Guide and Ingredient Substitutions: https://essenrecipes.substack.com/p/easy-ground-beef-potato-dinner

Please Subscribe, Like and Share with friends and family, or I will eat your dessert 😋🤩 
Thank you for watching 😘 Have a delicious day 😋

Yours  @EssenRecipes
video_tags: if you have potatoes and ground beef
top_comments: What's your favorite potato dish?
Kids laughing in the background and scrumptious food being cooked, it’s as good as it gets 🙌🏼

Here is the recipe in writing: Season beef with salt & pepper, let it brown a little. Add one chopped shallot (or substitute with one red onion according to some random google search I found), and let that simmer for 2-3 minutes. 
Add 2 sliced cloves of garlic. Cook for 30 seconds. Add 2 tablespoons or tomato paste, add 1 teaspoon of sweet paprika. cook for 1 minute. Add a touch of wostherschire sauce.  Add 240 ml of beef broth. Simmer for 7 minutes. 
Slice 4 potatoes, very thin. (might have to transfer to a pan for the oven – my frying pan does NOT go in the oven – I moved the meat to a casserole dish at this point).     
Turn the heat off, place potatoes on top, all layered evenly like.   Add salt.

In this step-by-step DIY tutorial, we show you the entire process of casting concrete using real leaves as molds to create beautiful, textured leaf tiers, alongside building a sturdy, hand-sculpted cement tree branch frame. This is a brilliant "best out of waste" and budget-friendly crafting project that adds a touch of rustic, handmade charm to any outdoor space.

#DIYGardenDecor #CementCrafts #BestOutOfWaste #ConcretePlanter #GardenSculpture
video_tags: • best out of waste garden decor

Combining those natural impressions with a hand-shaped cement branch frame gives the whole project a very organic and artistic look. What I really like is that it feels handmade without looking rough or unfinished. congratulations.

Do I ever love this project ❤ Already thinking I have a perfect stand I could use and which leaves to pick to do this!  Thank you 🙏. Such a fabulous idea-the birds will flock to it for baths in my garden 👍👏

Maravilloso trabajo 😊😊

video.video_title: 10 + Easy Backyard Makeover DIY Garden Ideas Anyone Can Try
video.video_description:
Looking for creative ways to decorate your backyard? 🌿✨
In this video, you’ll discover amazing DIY garden ideas using cement, plastic bottles, old tires, wood, and recycled materials to create beautiful outdoor decorations and landscaping projects.

These easy DIY garden projects are perfect for transforming small gardens, patios, balconies, and backyards into stylish and cozy outdoor spaces. From creative cement crafts and planter ideas to recycled garden decorations and wooden landscaping designs, this video is packed with inspiration for every gardening lover.

Whether you enjoy backyard makeover projects, garden decor ideas, or sustainable gardening hacks, these simple and budget-friendly ideas can help you create a stunning outdoor space at home.

✔️ DIY cement garden ideas
✔️ Garden decoration with recycled materials
✔️ Tire planter ideas
✔️ Plastic bottle garden hacks
✔️ Wooden garden decor inspiration
✔️ Backyard landscaping ideas

video.video_title: What Prison Training Gets Right About Muscle Growth
video.video_description:
→ 8-Week BuiltSimple Foundation: https://www.builtsimple.eu/builtsimple-foundation
→ Free Training Resources: https://www.builtsimple.eu/

If you want to use the same Calisthenics Equipment I use and support my Mission with BuiltSimple, click here: 
https://www.gornation.com/?ref=builtsimple10


Most people think you need a gym, machines, and a complicated workout plan to build muscle.

But a few months ago I had an interesting conversation about training with someone who had just come out of prison.

Five years ago he was the owner of the gym where I was doing personal training. 

After serving time, we met again last November and started talking about workouts, strength, and how people actually train inside prison.


What surprised me was this:
He came out more muscular than when he went in.
No gym.
No machines.
Just bodyweight training.

Inside prison, inmates rely almost entirely on calisthenics and bodyweight workouts. 
But despite the lack of equipment, many prisoners develop impressive strength and muscle using simple but effective training principles.

In this video we break down the three training lessons from prison workouts that actually work:
• Why time under tension can build muscle without adding weight
• Why half reps and constant tension are often misunderstood but effective
• Why high volume calisthenics training works for strength and hypertrophy

These ideas are surprisingly similar to the philosophy behind simple, sustainable training:
Focusing on basic movements, effort, and consistency over complicated programs.


If you’re interested in calisthenics training, bodyweight workouts, prison workouts, minimalist fitness, or simple strength training, these principles can completely change how you think about training.

Strength doesn’t always come from better equipment.
Sometimes it comes from doing the basics harder and more consistently.

0:00 Background Story
1:00 Prison Gyms
1:10 Tempo Reps
1:58 Half Reps
2:39 Volume as Progression
3:25 Minimalist Training
3:57 My Idea & Why behind this Video
4:10 Just Do This
top_comments:
Do perfect set-ups make us more comfortable? And how is it that we see so many people training better under "worse" conditions? This is not referring to prison now.

My family doesn't come from a rich country and I see the same thing there at the outdoor calisthenics parks.

Inside prison and in these parks  it's mostly pushups, pullups, and dips - but done with insane consistency, volume, and effort.

Meanwhile, many people with unlimited equipment constantly change programs.

What do you think matters more?
Simple training done hard
or
Perfect programs & Set-Ups?
One word: Consistency.

As a former inmate who spent 7 years in prison I can say with all certainty that bodyweight training is not to be underestimated ! I still do it to this day in spite of the fact that I have lots of workout equipment I prefer calisthenics and bodyweight training..
Jesse Pawlak has an awesome channel about working out whilst he was behind bars.

What they also have that's worth mentioning is TIME. They literally have nothing else to do, no every day problems, work, family etc. Just eat, sleep and work out. That alone can make a big difference.

4:10 simple movements -- the prison system forces the simplicity upon the inmate.  Outside the prison, in day to day life, simplicity helps people maintain consistency, and without consistency nothing ever progresses or changes.
My vision of hell is a gym crowded... I do calisthenics by sheer misanthropy
Yes I did 29 years in prison. many people did many sets, many reps and half  reps. I just did a video on this too. Keep it up. People want to know about this
I did solely calisthenics during COVID in parks usually. Felt great for sure and was still strong. Especially with pullups and dips
It's amazing how training has evolved even over the last 20yrs.

If you’re interested in calisthenics training, bodyweight workouts, prison workouts, minimalist fitness, or simple strength training, these principles can completely change how you think about training.

Strength doesn’t always come from better equipment.
Sometimes it comes from doing the basics harder and more consistently.

- Organize and manage conversations
- Move chats into projects

Claude Projects helps you keep related conversations, files, and instructions together in one place, so Claude understands the context across all your chats. - Create a new Claude Project
- Add project instructions
- Upload files and documents
- Use files as context across chats
- Organize and manage conversations
- Move chats into projects
- Archive old projects
